entity: Swissoil (umbrella association of Swiss fuel/heating-oil traders; affiliated with Avenergy Suisse)
detail: President of Swissoil, the association of fuel and heating-oil traders, from 2015 (succeeding Caspar Baader) until 2022. Swissoil shares its Zurich business address and management with the oil association Avenergy Suisse (formerly Erdoel-Vereinigung). During his tenure he campaigned against the 2021 CO2 Act. The mandate was reported to have been removed from his personal website during his 2022 candidacy.

entity: auto-schweiz (Association of Official Swiss Automobile Importers)
status: historical (resigned on election to Federal Council)
detail: Elected president of auto-schweiz, the association of official Swiss automobile importers, in May/June 2022; held the post only until the end of 2022 because of his election to the Federal Council.

entity: Aktion fuer eine vernuenftige Energiepolitik Schweiz (AVES) - pro-nuclear energy-policy association
detail: Elected president of AVES in May 2014, a long-standing pro-nuclear-energy lobby organisation.

President of the Swiss Water Management Association (hydropower / water-management interests), one of the mandates listed in the parliamentary Register of Interests before his Federal Council election.
President of the Agricultural Information Service (LID) from 2007 to 2014.

entity: Various boards and associations (parliamentary Register of Interests)
role: Board member / president of multiple bodies
status: historical (relinquished on election to Federal Council)
detail: At the time of his Federal Council candidacy Roesti held roughly 16 mandates listed in the parliamentary Register of Interests, spanning firms, associations and lobby groups - reported to include the car importers, the water-management association, the Grand Casino Bern and the breeding association for Freiberger horses, among others. Federal Council members may not hold gainful secondary mandates; he relinquished these on taking office and his consultancy was liquidated.
